SHNs were decoded to wave and Audition 2.0 was used to reassemble
the tracks back to 1 long wave.  Audition 2.0 was used to align &
synch the SBD & AUD sources.  
- Aud and sbd were synced while working on a dts encoded cd, matrix, video dvd and audio dvd
- Mixed by kevtobin@yahoo.com 
- DVD authoring via DVDMaestro by Kevin Tobin.

Audio Patching:
1) Between Jack Straw and Tennessee Jed, 27.452 seconds were missing from the audience source (AUD1)  and was filled in with audio from the original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better.
 
2) Between Jack Straw and Tennessee Jed, 1 minute and 19.338 seconds were missing from the sbd source (SBD)  and was filled in with audio from both the audience source (AUD1) and original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better.

3) Between Friend of the Devil and Bird Song, 7 minutes 50.713 seconds were missing from the audience source (AUD1) and filled in with audio from the original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better and was all of Mama Tried > Mexicalli Blues. 

4) Between Friend of the Devil and Mama Tried, 21.582 seconds were missing from the sbd source (SBD1) and filled in with audio from the original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better and included the first 10 seconds of Mama Tried.

5) Between Mexicali Blues and Bird Song, 1 minute and 25.504 seconds were missing from the sbd source (SBD1) and filled in with audio from the original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better and included the first 10 seconds of Mama Tried.

6) At the end of Deal, 9.343 seconds were missing from the sbd source (SBD1) and filled in with audio from the audience source (AUD1). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better.

7) During Drums, 5.947 seconds were missing from the audience source (AUD1) and filled in with audio from the original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better. 

8) During Drums, 8.412 seconds were missing from the audience source (AUD1) and filled in with audio from the original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better. 

9) Between Good Loving and Brokedown Palace, 3 minute 7.779 seconds were missing from the audience source (AUD1)  and filled in with audio from the original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better. 

10) Between Good Loving and Brokedown Palace, 3 minute 17.482 seconds were missing from the sbd source (SBD1)  and filled in with audio from the audience source (AUD1) and original video soundtrack (AUD2). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better. 

11) At the end of Brokedown Palace, 7.323 seconds were missing from the sbd source (SBD1) and filled in with audio from the audience source (AUD1). This portion of the audio was normalized to blend in better.
